title: Atrocities by the Hour
author: Stan Cox
content:
With the western world’s attention having turned almost completely away from
Occupied Palestine this summer, Israeli armed forces and settler shock troops
have surged ahead in Gaza and the West Bank with an especially potent cocktail
of genocide and apartheid. Hani al-Masri, director of the Palestinian Center
for Strategic Studies, told Mondoweiss in late July […]
